title: Merchandise

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Treat the object and the relationship statement as part of brand use so a logo is not placed on an unsuitable or misleading giveaway.
strategic_value: Controlled merchandise use can keep IBM identification consistent with the approved partnership and object context.
demonstration: A rule column sits beside shirt and tote examples, with crossed disposable-cup and plug-in-device examples at right.
practical_value: Check object eligibility, relationship wording and artwork approval before producing partner merchandise.

content_islands.name: Rules
content_islands.spec: Place eligibility, prohibited-object, registration-mark and approval guidance in the left column.

content_islands.name: Reusable examples
content_islands.spec: Show shirt front/back and tote concepts in the central column, with the relationship-tagline requirement above.

content_islands.name: Rejected objects
content_islands.spec: Show a disposable cup and wall-powered device crossed in red at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The examples show partner-led shirts and a tote with supporting logos and relationship wording.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Artwork requires approval; authorized use is limited to reusable items, excludes disposable and for-profit event merchandise, wireless/Bluetooth devices, lithium-battery items and wall-powered items. Two or more logos require a relationship tagline.

ingredient.name: IBM mark on partner merchandise
ingredient.role: Acknowledge the partnership on suitable reusable objects.
ingredient.application: Use approved artwork only on eligible reusable items and include a relationship tagline whenever two or more logos appear.
ingredient.scope: Version1.2 strategic-partner merchandise guidance. The source excludes disposable, event-for-profit, wireless/Bluetooth, lithium-battery and wall-powered items; registration marks are omitted on clothing and illegibly small applications.
